topic: Memory Hierarchy and Caching Strategies: Time Minimization
explanation: Modern computer systems employ a memory hierarchy to bridge the speed gap between CPU and main memory.  This hierarchy consists of multiple levels of storage with varying speeds and capacities.  Caching strategies aim to exploit locality of reference (temporal and spatial) to minimize access time to frequently used data.  Efficient caching is crucial for performance optimization.
